column1: # Grasp lab (M1 chat, 2026-10-10): perception from sim truth (SCENEREPLICA_PERCEPTION=truth, no
# camera models), scripted single pick, sim overlay, the 100 cases, GraspGenX box filter off
# everywhere. lab-1try (lab-check's settings, one grasp try) measures M1's retry against
# lab-check-fast. lab-check and lab-check-gap run on 6215ace91; everything from
# lab-check-fast on runs on the fast self-filter tip (same masks, ~50x less CPU), and
# lab-check-fast (lab-check's settings) bridges the two. lab-depth (mustafa/feat/grasp-depth-search: fast tip
# plus the grasp depth search) is compared against lab-check-gap. lab-depth-v3 is the earlier
# depth search (82d98f7d7: moved grasps used whenever they pass), kept for comparison, not rerun.

lab-check           mustafa/test/grasp-lab  dimos.evals.suites.scenereplica  3  -  SCENEREPLICA_PERCEPTION=truth SCENEREPLICA_GRASP=graspgenx PICKANDPLACEMODULE__GRASP_SCENE_FILTER=false GRASPGENXMODULE__MAX_CANDIDATES=500 MANIPULATIONMODULE__VISUALIZATION__BACKEND=none MATRIX_AGENT=matrix_scripted

lab-check-gap       mustafa/test/grasp-lab  dimos.evals.suites.scenereplica  3  -  SCENEREPLICA_PERCEPTION=truth SCENEREPLICA_GRASP=graspgenx PICKANDPLACEMODULE__GRASP_SCENE_FILTER=false GRASPGENXMODULE__MAX_CANDIDATES=500 PICKANDPLACEMODULE__GRASP_REQUIRE_OBJECT_IN_GAP=true MANIPULATIONMODULE__VISUALIZATION__BACKEND=none MATRIX_AGENT=matrix_scripted
